PROGRAM tank_level
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; (* Measured tank level in percent *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    PumpIn : BOOL; (* Inlet pump *)
    ValveOut : BOOL; (* Outlet drain valve *)
END_VAR
VAR
    LowLimitReached : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

(* Control logic for pump and valve operation *)
IF Level <= 10 THEN
    LowLimitReached := TRUE;
ELSIF Level >= 90 THEN
    LowLimitReached := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level <= 10 THEN
    PumpIn := TRUE;
ELSIF Level >= 90 THEN
    PumpIn := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level >= 90 THEN
    ValveOut := TRUE;
ELSE
    ValveOut := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level >= 90 THEN
    PumpIn := FALSE;
END_IF

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM heater_ctrl
VAR_INPUT
    HeatRequest : BOOL;  // Heat demand
    Enable : BOOL;       // System enable
    OverTemp : BOOL;     // Over-temperature (TRUE = too hot)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Heater : BOOL;       // Heater element
END_VAR
VAR
    Timer1 : TON;        // Timer instance
END_VAR

// Timer not used as there are no time-based requirements in the given specification
Timer1(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1s);

// Control logic
IF OverTemp THEN
    Heater := FALSE; // Safety cut-off in case of over-temperature
ELSIF HeatRequest AND Enable THEN
    Heater := TRUE;  // Energize heater when demand is present and system is enabled
ELSE
    Heater := FALSE; // Default state when no demand or system is not enabled
END_IF

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM elevator
VAR_INPUT
    CallUp : BOOL;
    CallDown : BOOL;
    DoorClosed : BOOL;
    AtTop : BOOL;
    AtBottom : BOOL;
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorUp : BOOL;
    MotorDown : BOOL;
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT := 0;
END_VAR

MotorUp := FALSE;
MotorDown := FALSE;

CASE State OF
    0:  (* At-bottom *)
        IF CallUp AND DoorClosed AND NOT AtTop THEN
            State := 1; (* Moving-up *)
        END_IF

    1:  (* Moving-up *)
        IF AtTop OR NOT DoorClosed THEN
            State := 2; (* At-top *)
        ELSE
            MotorUp := TRUE;
        END_IF

    2:  (* At-top *)
        IF CallDown AND DoorClosed AND NOT AtBottom THEN
            State := 3; (* Moving-down *)
        END_IF

    3:  (* Moving-down *)
        IF AtBottom OR NOT DoorClosed THEN
            State := 0; (* At-bottom *)
        ELSE
            MotorDown := TRUE;
        END_IF

    ELSE
        State := 0; (* Default to At-bottom in case of an invalid state *)
END_CASE

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM elevator
VAR_INPUT
    CallUp : BOOL;
    CallDown : BOOL;
    DoorClosed : BOOL;
    AtTop : BOOL;
    AtBottom : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorUp : BOOL;
    MotorDown : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    State : INT := 0; // 0 = AtBottom, 1 = MovingUp, 2 = AtTop, 3 = MovingDown
END_VAR

// Initialize outputs
MotorUp := FALSE;
MotorDown := FALSE;

// State machine logic
CASE State OF
    0: // AtBottom
        IF CallUp AND DoorClosed AND NOT AtTop THEN
            State := 1; // Start MovingUp
        END_IF

    1: // MovingUp
        IF NOT DoorClosed THEN
            State := 0; // Safety: Return to AtBottom if the door opens
        ELSIF AtTop THEN
            State := 2; // Transition to AtTop when reached
        ELSE
            MotorUp := TRUE; // Continue moving up
        END_IF

    2: // AtTop
        IF CallDown AND DoorClosed AND NOT AtBottom THEN
            State := 3; // Start MovingDown
        END_IF

    3: // MovingDown
        IF NOT DoorClosed THEN
            State := 2; // Safety: Return to AtTop if the door opens
        ELSIF AtBottom THEN
            State := 0; // Transition to AtBottom when reached
        ELSE
            MotorDown := TRUE; // Continue moving down
        END_IF

    ELSE
        State := 0; // Default to AtBottom if out of known states
END_CASE

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM tank_cycle
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; (* Tank level percent *)
    StartCycle : BOOL; (* Start batch cycle *)
    EStop : BOOL; (* Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated *)
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Pump : BOOL; (* Inlet pump *)
    Valve : BOOL; (* Outlet drain valve *)
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT := 0; (* 0=Idle, 1=Filling, 2=Draining *)
END_VAR

(* Safety conditions *)
IF NOT EStop THEN
    State := 0;
END_IF

(* State machine logic *)
CASE State OF
    0: (* Idle *)
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF StartCycle AND EStop AND Level < 90 THEN
            State := 1;
        END_IF

    1: (* Filling *)
        Pump := TRUE;
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF Level >= 90 THEN
            State := 2;
        END_IF

    2: (* Draining *)
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := TRUE;
        IF Level <= 10 THEN
            State := 0;
        END_IF
END_CASE

(* Ensure safety conditions are met *)
IF Level >= 90 THEN
    Pump := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level <= 10 THEN
    Valve := FALSE;
END_IF
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM tank_cycle
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; // Tank level percent
    StartCycle : BOOL; // Start batch cycle
    EStop : BOOL; // Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Pump : BOOL; // Inlet pump
    Valve : BOOL; // Outlet drain valve
END_VAR
VAR
    State : INT := 0; // 0=Idle, 1=Filling, 2=Draining
END_VAR

// Safety and state management
IF NOT EStop THEN
    State := 0; // Force to Idle
END_IF

CASE State OF
    0: // Idle
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF EStop AND StartCycle AND Level < 90 THEN
            State := 1; // Transition to Filling
        END_IF

    1: // Filling
        Pump := Level < 90; // Pump is on if below HIGH
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF Level >= 90 THEN
            State := 2; // Transition to Draining
        END_IF

    2: // Draining
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := Level > 10; // Valve is on if above LOW
        IF Level <= 10 THEN
            State := 0; // Return to Idle
        END_IF

    ELSE
        State := 0; // Default to Idle
END_CASE
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM two_hand
VAR_INPUT
    LH : BOOL;    // Left-hand button
    RH : BOOL;    // Right-hand button
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    Actuator : BOOL;    // Press actuator
END_VAR

VAR
    Armed : BOOL := FALSE;    // Anti-tie-down armed flag
END_VAR

IF NOT LH AND NOT RH THEN
    Armed := TRUE;
ELSIF (LH XOR RH) THEN
    Armed := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Armed AND LH AND RH THEN
    Actuator := TRUE;
ELSE
    Actuator := FALSE;
END_IF
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM gate
VAR_INPUT
    OpenCmd : BOOL;
    CloseCmd : BOOL;
    OpenLimit : BOOL;
    CloseLimit : BOOL;
    Obstruction : BOOL;
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorOpen : BOOL;
    MotorClose : BOOL;
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT := 0; // 0=Idle, 1=Opening, 2=Closing
END_VAR

// Ensure mutual exclusion of motor outputs
MotorOpen := FALSE;
MotorClose := FALSE;

CASE State OF
    0: // Idle
        IF OpenCmd AND NOT OpenLimit THEN
            State := 1; // Transition to Opening
        ELSIF CloseCmd AND NOT CloseLimit AND NOT Obstruction THEN
            State := 2; // Transition to Closing
        END_IF

    1: // Opening
        IF OpenLimit THEN
            State := 0; // Transition to Idle
        ELSE
            MotorOpen := TRUE; // Drive gate open
        END_IF

    2: // Closing
        IF CloseLimit OR Obstruction THEN
            State := 0; // Transition to Idle
        ELSE
            MotorClose := TRUE; // Drive gate closed
        END_IF

    ELSE
        State := 0; // Default transition to Idle
END_CASE
END_PROGRAM
